scope: Full original recursive FillBuffers and actual short/float packing, supplied one parent/two children/texture descriptor. Two held renders per case; scalar sin/cos are Python-math-to-f32 stubs and AngPos explicitly returns0 for oriented cases. Exact geometry/UV/RGBA8 and in-place child RGBA bits recorded. No GPU, actual atlas allocation, original resource parser, room/culling or game port.
